query: Best street food spots and street food markets in Hanoi

places.title: Banh Mi 25
places.text: An absolute favorite among tourists and locals alike, Banh Mi 25 is celebrated for its crispy, warm baguettes filled with flavorful pâté, barbecued pork, fresh herbs, and pickled vegetables. Offering a variety of traditional and modern fillings, including vegetarian options, this busy street stall combines quality ingredients with incredibly fast service. Customers can enjoy their meal in a simple seating area across the road.
places.opening_hours: Monday - Sunday: 7:00 AM - 9:00 PM
places.address: 25 P. Hàng Cá, Phố cổ Hà Nội, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội 100000, Vietnam

places.title: Bún chả Hương Liên
places.text: Universally famous as the spot where US President Barack Obama and Chef Anthony Bourdain famously shared a meal, Bun Cha Huong Lien serves exceptional charcoal-grilled pork patties and pork belly in a sweet-savory broth, accompanied by vermicelli noodles and fresh herbs. Despite its global fame, it remains an authentic, down-to-earth street food institution offering a legendary dining experience.
places.opening_hours: Monday - Sunday: 8:00 AM - 8:00 PM
places.address: 24 P. Lê Văn Hưu, Cửa Nam, Hà Nội, Vietnam

places.title: Phở Gia Truyền Bát Đàn
places.text: For an authentic taste of Hanoi's signature noodle dish, Phở Gia Truyền Bát Đàn is legendary. Having served customers for generations, this classic noodle shop is famous for its long queues and deeply flavorful beef broth. The beef is exceptionally tender, the noodles are fresh, and the experience of eating on low stools at this historic spot is a quintessential Hanoi street food ritual.
places.opening_hours: Monday - Sunday: 6:00 AM - 11:00 AM, 5:00 PM - 9:30 PM
places.address: 49 P. Bát Đàn, Phố cổ Hà Nội, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, Vietnam

places.title: Ta Hien Beer Street
places.text: Known locally as 'Beer Street,' Ta Hien is the ultimate nighttime destination in the Old Quarter. Packed with low plastic stools spilling onto the narrow streets, it’s famous for serving cheap draft beer (bia hoi) alongside legendary street eats like fried fermented pork rolls, grilled squid, and roasted bird. The energetic, chaotic vibe makes it a fantastic social and culinary hub.
places.opening_hours: Friday - Sunday: 7:00 PM - 11:00 PM (Pedestrian hours)
places.address: 41-36 P. Lương Ngọc Quyến, Phố cổ Hà Nội, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, Vietnam

places.text: Stretching through the historic Old Quarter, this vibrant weekend market is a paradise for street food enthusiasts. Every Friday, Saturday, and Sunday evening, the streets come alive with countless stalls serving local favorites like grilled skewers, sweet soup desserts (che), sticky rice, and cheap, delicious snacks. It is a must-visit for soaking up Hanoi's energetic nightlife.
places.opening_hours: Friday - Sunday: 6:00 PM - 11:00 PM

places.text: Tucked away right next to the historic Dong Xuan Market, this narrow daytime food alley is one of Hanoi’s best-kept secrets for traditional culinary experiences. It offers a nostalgic, bustling local dining atmosphere.
